meta.title: AssignModeView

fields.name: affectedGroups
fields.mapping: derived:distinct(groupId) across signalIds, excluding empty groupId

meta.description: Same in-progress Assign screen state as AssignFlowView, now with assignMode='Group' — affectedGroups is recomputed as distinct(groupId) across signalIds, dropping any signal whose groupId is empty (e.g. Pete's signal 2 in the example selection).
